system_prompt_style.note: Messages are built with format strings from goal/plan; system messages in the planning and summary calls are also formatted with the goal. No line numbers shown in evidence; line estimated.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: We use axtree by default. Alternatively, you can provide a comma-separated string listing the desired input feature types.
env_context_strategy.note: The page observation (axtree by default) is used for action grounding. The model navigates through browser tools. Closest value for the web domain.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: we cannot use ot directly since ot typically contains extensive semantic information, making it too long and consuming too many tokens, so we only pass the trajectory ofrt as input
context_compaction.note: Observations are excluded from the action-generation context. The paper also mentions element filters that reduce token usage.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Examples include the Accessibility Tree (AXTree), simplified DOM (Document Object Model), screenshots, Sets of Marks (SOM), and interactive elements.
observation_format.note: axtree is the default feature. The other values are selectable with --features. Tool responses are returned as str(response).

tool_call_format.note: FunctionCallingAgent is the default (it is the one used in the quickstart). PromptAgent generates high-level actions in text form (the BrowserGym action set), and these are grounded into Playwright code.

tool_count.note: tools/registry.py is not shown. The paper lists navigation, upload file, select option and webscraping tools, but the count cannot be verified from the evidence.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: it can access web browser related tools like navigation for clicking elements, scrolling, and page navigation, as well as functionalities for uploading files, selecting op-tions, and web scraping.
edit_primitive.note: No file-editing tool is listed; this is a web agent.

tool_schema_source.note: registry.py is not shown, so the schema source is inferred.

protocol_standardization.note: No MCP or A2A appears in the file tree. CDP is a browser protocol, not an agent protocol.

loop_primitives.note: The default is a plan followed by a recursive function-calling loop. Tree search is in PromptAgent through branching_factor and in separate repos.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: If no plan is provided, we generate an initial plan using a prompting method
planning_granularity.note: The plan is free text that is appended to messages and written to plan.txt. The HighLevelPlanningAgent replans.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: In this work, we focus specifically on web agents.

human_in_loop.note: Tool calls run without approval. The user can send follow-up plan prompts in the chat UI.

long_term_memory.note: Opt-in AWM workflow memory via --workflow_memory_website. It is off by default.

self_verification.note: Used in PromptAgent. The default FunctionCallingAgent has none. Post-action feedback is captured.

rollback.note: The tree-search replay module is in a separate repo.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
if depth >= 8:
            return "max depth reached, agent stops execution"
termination_condition.note: Model-declared termination means the model stops when no tool calls are made.

cost_controls.note: Token usage is only logged. Element filters reduce tokens.

execution_isolation.note: Local Playwright Chromium is used. Alternatives are the remote BrowserBase browser and CDP attachment to an existing Chrome.

network_policy.evidence_quote: You are ready to go! Try FunctionCallingAgent on google.com

tracing.evidence_quote: logger.info('agent: %s, depth: %s, response: %s', self.model_name, depth, response)
tracing.note: A log folder is used and log/flow/example.json exists, which suggests possible structured flow logs.

replayability.evidence_quote: We implement a robust replay module that executes action trajectories starting from an initial URL.
replayability.note: The replay module is in the tree-search extension repo.

eval_hooks.note: evaluation_suite/ and run_xwebarena_evaluate.py are in the repo.
